title: Managing coccidiosis pressure in broilers
content: Wet litter, bloody droppings, reduced feed intake, and poor growth can indicate coccidiosis pressure. Early isolation and litter correction reduce spread.

title: Broiler temperature management
content: Temperature and humidity should be monitored against age-specific targets because heat stress reduces feed efficiency and increases respiratory load.

title: Respiratory disease warning signs
content: Open-mouth breathing, nasal discharge, and sudden drop in activity should trigger ventilation review and veterinary assessment.
